verdict.rationale: Cloudflare runs its own fleet of managed remote MCP servers. They are documented as letting users connect from an MCP client and 'use natural language to accomplish tasks through your Cloudflare account', including a Code Mode server covering the entire Cloudflare API. A Skills plugin and agent-setup hub extend this to many agents, and probes confirm the servers are live (one keyless, one OAuth-gated). Natural-language operation still depends on a third-party agent client. missing for 10: a native natural-language interface within Cloudflare's own dashboard/CLI, independent hands-on corroboration of real tasks completed via natural language (probes only verify MCP initialize/auth).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: allowing you to connect to Cloudflare's service from an MCP client (e.g. Cursor, Claude) and use natural language to accomplish tasks through your Cloudflare account
provides access to the entire Cloudflare API — over 2,500 endpoints across DNS, Workers, R2, Zero Trust, and every other product — through just two tools: search() and execute()
You can install the Cloudflare Skills plugin, which bundles the Cloudflare MCP servers alongside contextual skills and slash commands for building on Cloudflare.
a live, OAuth-gated remote MCP server per the MCP authorization spec
